claim: Aipol Aventura charges €35 adult / €25 child (under 12) for the 2026 Sella descent; price includes modern 1-3 seat canoes, paddles, life vests, waterproof container, parking, hot showers, and return transport; minimum age 5, minimum height 1.15 m, must know how to swim
quote: Adultos: €35 per person; Children (under 12): €25 per person; Pets: Free; Optional picnic: €5 (Asturian) or €7 (vegetarian/gluten-free)... canoas modernas de 1, 2 y 3 plazas, remos, bidón estanco y chalecos... Minimum age: 5 years old; Minimum height: 1.15 meters

claim: Frontera Verde offers two Sella routes: Arriondas-Toraño (8 km, 1.5-2 h) and Arriondas-Omedina (14 km, 3.5-4 h); €35 adult / €25 child, €45 on International Descent day (Aug 8 2026); picnic +€5; return van to Arriondas continuous from 14:00, river closes 18:00
quote: Adults: €35/person; Children (5-12 years): €25/child... International descent (Aug 8): €45/person... Arriondas to Toraño: 8 km, approximately 1.5-2 hours; Arriondas to Omedina: 14 km, approximately 3.5-4 hours... Recogidas a partir de las 14:00 ininterrumpidamente

claim: TurAventura prices scale by group size: €25/person for 1-10, down to €17-18 for 40+, €15 for children under 12; International Descent priced at €30/person
quote: 1-10 people: €25/person; 11-20 people: €22/person; 21-40 people: €19-20/person; 40+ people: €17-18/person; Children under 12: €15/person. International Descent: €30/person

claim: The 88th Descenso Internacional del Sella race is Saturday 8 August 2026, departing from Arriondas bridge at 12:00; declared a Fiesta de Interés Turístico Internacional with cannon-fire start, 'Asturias, patria querida' anthem, the Tren Fluvial spectator train, and traditional fabada + arroz con leche meal at Campos de la Oba (Lloviu)
quote: Date: Saturday, August 8, 2026. Start Time: 12:00 h (noon) from Arriondas facilities... A solemn rendition of 'Asturias, patria querida'... Cannon fire marking the official start... The 'Tren Fluvial' (river train)... Conclusion at Campos de la Oba (Lloviu) with traditional Asturian meal featuring fava beans and rice pudding

claim: Race-day timetable: 8:00-11:30 kayak assembly, 11:00 folk parade with traditional bands, 12:00 cannon start, first paddlers reach Ribadesella 13:10-13:45, prize ceremony 17:00 at Ribadesella bridge, then evening cider and concerts; race covers 20 km Arriondas to Ribadesella
quote: 8:00-11:30: Kayak assembly and boat inspections; 11:00: Folk parade with traditional bands; 12:00: Cannon shot and official departure from Arriondas bridge; 13:10-13:45: First paddlers arrive in Ribadesella; 17:00: Prize ceremony at Ribadesella bridge

claim: Rafting takes place on the upper Sella between Campurriondi and Estayos (Class II with a Class III finish at Los Estayos), in 6-8-person rafts with certified guide; season March 1 to October 31, best flow March-May from Picos snowmelt
quote: Class II level, with wide passages and predictable rapids suitable for beginners, though the final section 'Los Estayos' is classified as Class III... between Campurriondi and Estayos (where the Dobra River meets the Sella). The season runs from March 1 to October 31

claim: Canyoning trips depart Arriondas across canyons including Cuevón de Pruneda, Carangas, La Molina (Cabrales), Vallegón, Vivoli, Tinganón (Ribadesella) and family-friendly Rubo; prices €50-€80 for 2 to 4¾-hour sessions
quote: Cuevón de Pruneda (medium-high level); Barranco Carangas (multiple difficulty levels); Barranco La Molina in Cabrales; Barranco Vallegón (medium level); Barranco Vivoli (medium-high level); La Cueva'l Tinganón in Ribadesella; Barranco Rubo (family-friendly option)... Prices range from €50–€80

claim: Horseback rides leave Arriondas/Cangas de Onís in 1- or 2-hour formats at €25 adult / €20 child (≤12), passing the village of Coviella with hórreos and an 18th-c. palace before mountain views of the Sueve and Picos; helmet, rain cape, guide and insurance included; minimum rider height 1.30 m
quote: 1-hour rides (most common for beginners); 2-hour rides. Pricing: €25 per adult; €20 per child (up to 12 years old)... Minimum height of 1.30 meters... passing through the village of Coviella where you can see traditional Asturian constructions (hórreos) and an 18th-century palace

claim: Ulex Paragliding Club School is the Arriondas-based paragliding operator at Finca Fundición de Coviella-El portazgo (tel +34 985 841 282), federated with the Principality of Asturias and offering tandem flights with instructor for first-time flyers
quote: Ulex Paragliding Club School is located at Finca Fundición de Coviella-El portazgo, 33540 Arriondas, with contact number +985 841 282... two-seater paragliders and qualified pilot instructors who make flights with those interested in trying flying without needing to take a learning course

claim: Rana Sella rents high-end e-MTBs from the Coviella (Arriondas) base, using carbon-frame MMR bikes with internal batteries and Bosch 4th-gen motors
quote: Bicycles are available at facilities in Finca La Fundición de Coviella, in Arriondas. They offer high-end electric bicycles from the Asturian firm MMR, with carbon frames, internal batteries, and Bosch fourth-generation motor systems

claim: Senda del Oso bike-rental centre charges €40/bike/day for Conor 29"/27.5" e-bikes with a €180 card hold; in early 2026 the operator is switching from rear-motor to centre-motor models to open routes beyond the gentle green ones
quote: Rental prices are €40 per bike per day, with a €180 credit card deposit that is refunded upon return in perfect condition... they are making changes for 2026, moving away from rear motor e-bikes to allow usage beyond just green routes and low-incline paths
